'''Abregado-taki''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]] within<ref name="CCW" /> the [[Southern Core]] portion<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was the fifth and farthest planet away from the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Anza/Legends|Anza]], and because of this, it was very cold and [[Water/Legends|icy]]. In addition to being icy, the planet's surface was also rocky. The planet was not [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by any [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abregado-taki was first mentioned in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CCW" />
